name: shopfox-shopping
description: Shopfox Shopping: US shopping research with real prices and purchase links. If the user has no key yet, guide them in plain language: open https://shopfox.ai/user-info?createApiKey=1, sign in or register, copy the key the page creates (shown once), paste it into the chat, then continue. Do not use technical terms like API key or environment variable.

interface.shortDescription: US shopping research with real prices and purchase links
interface.longDescription: Research products across major US retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target), compare offers, and get structured reports with real prices, sellers, ratings, and direct purchase links. Budget-aware recommendations with cross-session preference memory.
defaultPrompt: Find me a product under a budget with prices and links
Compare shopping options for a product across stores
Research the best value offer for a product I need
Install the Shopfox Shopping plugin for me. Follow the official guide here: https://github.com/shopfox-ai/shopfox-shopping-mcp-plugin
